values.note: DCNR: 'Eighteen campsites have electricity. Five walk-in tent sites offer a secluded streamside setting.' The booking site lists the 18 Modern Electric sites in Loop A, mostly 35-40 ft (site 017 is 50 ft), all back-in.

values.note: The booking page lists the nearest camp store and laundromat as outside the campground (within 10 miles).

facilities.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/sizerville-state-park/stay ('Flush toilets, Showers, Sanitary dump station') + ReserveAmerica Services and Amenities for parkId 880124 (Potable Water, 'Nearest Camp Store Outside The Campground', 'Nearest Laundromat Outside Of Campground'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Campsites can be booked up to 11 months ahead and for the same day (ReserveAmerica booking window). 'The maximum stay in this camping area is 14 days during the summer season and 21 days during the off season', then 48 hours away before setting up again.

summary: Confirmed inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window/14-night max for this park; season (mid-April to mid-December) already manual. Added 50-amp electric at all 18 RV sites, 23 campsites (18 electric to 50 ft, all back-in, plus 5 walk-in tent sites), showers, flush toilets, water, dump, no camp store or laundry. Not stated for this park: water/sewer at sites, Saturday minimum (left inherited), noon cutoff, fcfs. Fees left as recorded.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: stored 'not waterfront' (evidence: satellite, campground in woods up Cowley Run valley, only a tiny forest stream). ReserveAmerica tags all 18 Modern Electric RV sites in Loop A 'Waterfront' with distance to lake/stream 'Less than 300 feet'; DCNR calls only the five walk-in tent sites 'streamside'. Re-check the Loop A pads against the stream; the existing call may well stand (a type-level tag proves nothing).
